question: Who among the following scaled Mount Everest 24 times and set a world record?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kami Rita Sherpa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kami Rita Sherpa** is a renowned Sherpa guide from Nepal who holds the record for the most ascents of Mount Everest.
 
• He reached the summit of Mount Everest for the **24th time on May 21, 2019**, setting a world record.
 
• Kami Rita Sherpa first scaled Everest in **1994** and has been climbing it almost every year since then.
 
• He has also scaled several other prominent peaks including K2, Cho-Oyu, Manaslu, and Lhotse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mount Everest:**

 
 
• Mount Everest is the Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
 
• The international border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China runs across its summit point.
 
• The current official height of Mount Everest is 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet), recognized by China and Nepal.
 
• The mountain was first summited by Sir Edmund Hillary of New Zealand and Tenzing Norgay, a Sherpa of Nepal, on May 29, 1953.
 
 
 
• **Sherpa People:**
 
 
• The Sherpa are an ethnic group from the most mountainous region of Nepal, high in the Himalayas.
 
• They are known for their mountaineering skills and are often employed as guides for expeditions in the Himalayas.
 
• Sherpas are highly regarded for their ability to navigate the treacherous mountain terrain and their physical endurance at high altitudes.
 
 
 
• **Mountaineering Records:**
 
 
• Setting records in mountaineering often involves multiple ascents of the same peak, demonstrating skill, endurance, and experience.
 
• Mountaineers like Kami Rita Sherpa play a crucial role in guiding and supporting international climbers on dangerous expeditions.
